text:
leo_ops: @here launching a small preview pool in Mexico City (mex1): dedicated-L100-mex1-preview. Initial capacity = 10 cards. Target: low-latency inference for LATAM traffic. :mexico:

leo_ops: Key things: preview pricing applies, reservations allowed, and a regional-fallback policy is enabled (primary mex1 -> fallback sfo1 -> global-hosted).

nina_pm: Can we call out billing and reservation UX so customers aren't surprised?

leo_ops: Yup. Billing note in Console banner + email to pilots. Reservation CLI and UI supported. Example CLI:

```
# reserve 2 cards in mex1 for 14 days
rb-reserve --pool dedicated-L100-mex1-preview --size 2 --duration 14d
```

ash_sre: Rollout schedule? We should add health checks to the SRE dashboard and smoke tests.

leo_ops: Canary begins 2026-03-26T02:00Z for 90m. Probes: `mex1-l100-smoke` and `mex1-l100-p95`. If fallback > 7% in first 30m we pause. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/mex1-l100 (internal).

ojas_sales: I'll notify pilot customers and include migration steps + a billing caveat. Any change in SLA for preview?

leo_ops: No SLA change for preview; just the billing note. Also status page will show "preview" tag.

tara_ce: Are quantization profiles baked into the images? Or do customers need to recompile?

ash_sre: We pre-load two common quant profiles (fp8-compat and int8-light). For custom topologies, one-time compile required. We've surfaced a warning in the reservation flow.

nina_pm: Let's add a short Console banner: "mex1 L100 preview may fallback to SFO1 during canary hours". Also include link to migration docs.

leo_ops: Banner added. Also enabling detailed fallback logging for first 48h (console + logs).

deploy-bot: Deployment triggered: pool `dedicated-L100-mex1-preview` at 2026-03-26T02:00:12Z (canary).

leo_ops: Ops anchors for the first 6 hours: watch token p95 latency, error rate, fallback %, and KV cache hit-rate. If fallback spike > 7% OR error rate > 0.5% we stop scale.

ojas_sales: Thanks - I'll prepare a short FAQ for pilots (migration steps, billing, expected latencies).

tara_ce: Can we schedule a 30m walkthrough tomorrow 09:00 PT for CE and Sales to rehearse demos?

leo_ops: Scheduled and calendar invite sent. :white_check_mark:
